accept.specs:
spec fn ref_pre(lo: i64, hi: i64) -> bool { lo <= hi }
spec fn ref_post(a: &[i64], b: &[i64], lo: i64, hi: i64) -> bool { a.len() == b.len() && (forall|k: usize| k < a.len() ==> lo <= #[trigger] a[k] && a[k] <= hi && ((lo <= b[k] && b[k] <= hi) ==> a[k] == b[k])) }
